svg.title: Microsoft CSP Commitment Ladder
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-csp-commitment-funnel; chapter number: 6; chart type: funnel; title: Microsoft CSP Commitment Ladder; subtitle: Direct-bill costs narrowing down to the indirect floor; caption: Direct bill now demands a $1 million trailing revenue bar, a billing marketplace and a paid support plan, while indirect resellers stay authorized on $1,000 a year.; assumptions note: Stages are ordered by dollar commitment, not by customer conversion. Conversion text quotes practitioner commentary and adds no computed rates.; note: Sources: Jeff Edwards and Scott May of Stratos Cloud Alliance [rV-Q2IVur6I @ 00:03:12, 00:08:45, 00:12:14]; Pax8 APAC [Xywyds1IfvM @ 00:05:09]; David Bujaider of Manage Protect [Je2jbg9tm0Q @ 00:09:37].; stages: label: Direct-bill CSP revenue bar; value: 1000000; display: $1,000,000 trailing CSP revenue; conversion: Up from $300,000; Pax8 expects upwards of two-thirds of direct partners to move indirect; detail: Also requires a solutions partner designation and a heavier security score.; label: Direct-bill billing marketplace build; value: 100000; display: Upwards of $100,000; conversion: Initial investment, then maintained in-house; detail: Scott May: direct-bill partners build and run the transacting marketplace with their own people and money.; label: Premier support plan spend; value: 50000; display: About $50,000 annually; conversion: Basic plan at least 15k if not more; detail: A premier or advanced support plan becomes mandatory for direct bill.; label: Indirect rebate threshold; value: 25000; display: $25,000 to chase rebates; conversion: Stratos: indirect resellers earn the exact same back-end incentives as direct sellers; detail: Rebate eligibility for indirect resellers.; label: Indirect authorization floor; value: 1000; display: $1,000 USD (about $1,500 AUD) per rolling 12 months; conversion: Minimum to stay an authorized CSP; detail: Confirm the Partner Center legal entity, address and current contact, then have a global admin accept the MPA.

circle.title: label: Direct-bill CSP revenue bar; value: 1000000; display: $1,000,000 trailing CSP revenue; conversion: Up from $300,000; Pax8 expects upwards of two-thirds of direct partners to move indirect; detail: Also requires a solutions partner designation and a heavier security score.

label: Direct-bill billing marketplace build; value: 100000; display: Upwards of $100,000; conversion: Initial investment, then maintained in-house; detail: Scott May: direct-bill partners build and run the transacting marketplace with their own people and money.

label: Premier support plan spend; value: 50000; display: About $50,000 annually; conversion: Basic plan at least 15k if not more; detail: A premier or advanced support plan becomes mandatory for direct bill.

label: Indirect rebate threshold; value: 25000; display: $25,000 to chase rebates; conversion: Stratos: indirect resellers earn the exact same back-end incentives as direct sellers; detail: Rebate eligibility for indirect resellers.

label: Indirect authorization floor; value: 1000; display: $1,000 USD (about $1,500 AUD) per rolling 12 months; conversion: Minimum to stay an authorized CSP; detail: Confirm the Partner Center legal entity, address and current contact, then have a global admin accept the MPA.

text.title: Assumptions: Stages are ordered by dollar commitment, not by customer conversion. Conversion text quotes practitioner commentary and adds no computed rates.
